title: rest source
description: Receives HTTPS requests with one method on a path of the REST address and replies with the flow's outcome, as Camel's REST DSL does.

method.title: Method
method.description: The HTTP method served; other methods get 405

path.title: Path
path.description: Path below the REST address, such as hello/me

consumes.title: Consumes
consumes.description: Media type of the requests; informational only

produces.title: Produces
produces.description: Content-Type of a reply whose message sets none

exchangePattern.title: Exchange pattern
exchangePattern.description: InOut replies with the message the flow ends with; InOnly replies at once with the request

address.title: REST address
address.description: host:port to listen on; Camel's rest configuration in the Java platform

serverIdentityFile.title: Server identity
serverIdentityFile.description: PKCS#12 keystore with the server's private key and certificate

serverIdentityPassword.title: Server identity password
serverIdentityPassword.description: Keystore password; env DIF_SERVER_IDENTITY_PASSWORD (or its _FILE companion)
